remarks: Welcome to this exceptional 1-bedroom condo located in a great San Pedro neighborhood. Featuring a rare two-level floor plan, this home offers a unique layout that brings a distinct sense of space, structure, and character rarely found in condo living. Enjoy everyday living and entertaining on your oversized balcony, where you can take in the scenic surroundings and gentle breezes. Located just moments from the beach, neighborhood shopping, and community amenities, this unique condo is ideal for anyone seeking comfort, style, and convenience in San Pedro. A quick drive brings you to downtown Long Beach for shopping, dining, and entertainment. This condo is truly one of a kind!
